dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: *sigh* You must have overheard me grumbling then...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I'm getting old now, and a lifetime of toiling away in this workshop has started to take its toll on the old joints...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Lately I've been thinking — it's time for me to take on an apprentice. Pass on what I've learned. Secure the future of the Fanmu Carpenter's.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: ...Don't s'pose you have any interest in woodwork yourself? The thought of turning a chunk of raw timber into a polished masterpiece by your own handiwork... appeal to you at all?

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: I don't know... You seem to me to have itchy feet. Places you have to go, things you have to do.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: How about you do what you've gotta do first. If when you come back I'm still around, then as long as I've got strength in my bones I'll be glad to take you on.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: When that time comes, I will devote myself fully to passing on everything I know. All the tricks of the trade of the Fanmu Carpenter's will be yours.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: What a pity. You'll never know the joy of working with wood.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Well, never mind. It's clear that you've got places to go, things to do.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: When you've done what you've gotta do, though... do come and find me if you change your mind.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: I'd devote myself fully to passing on everything I know. All the tricks of the trade of the Fanmu Carpenter's, they're yours to take if you want them.
